name: ollama-websearch
description: Ollama Cloud web search and web fetch as model-callable tools. Reasonix has no provider-side web search for the ollama-cloud endpoint (the `web_search = true` provider flag is documented only for the DeepSeek and OpenCode-Go presets), so this code extension serves the Ollama REST APIs directly.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return ranked results (title, url, content snippet). Use for current information: news, releases, documentation changes, or anything after the model's training cutoff. Prefer a short, specific query.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a single web page by URL and return its readable text content plus the links found on it. Use after web_search to read a specific result in full.
